evaluation.safety_evals: The developer cautions that the model can produce factually incorrect output and may generate lewd, biased, or otherwise offensive content due to limitations of the pretrained model and finetuning datasets, and advises safety testing before deployment.

identity.name: neural-chat-7b-v3-1
identity.summary: A fine-tuned 7B-parameter language model built from Mistral-7B-v0.1 using the Open-Orca/SlimOrca dataset.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Card explicitly cautions the model can produce factually incorrect output, and it is a text-output LLM fine-tuned on SlimOrca with no reported factual grounding.

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: Card advises safety testing before deployment and warns of factually incorrect/offensive outputs, implying users may over-trust fluent outputs in downstream decision-making.

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: Training/fine-tuning a 7B-parameter dense decoder-only model on large datasets and DPO alignment implies compute/energy/water use, though the card does not quantify it.

possible_risks.description: Applicable laws can establish data subject rights such as opt-out rights, right to access, and right to be forgotten. Synthetic data might raise unique concerns, such as the potential for reidentification of individuals from seemingly anonymous synthetic data. Data subject rights might also be relevant in scenarios where synthetic data is derived from sensitive or personal information.
possible_risks.justification: Open-Orca/SlimOrca and orca_dpo_pairs are derived from large web/text corpora that may contain personal data, and the card reports no privacy filtering or rights-alignment process.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight text model can be prompted with copyrighted material, and the card reports no guardrails or filtering for IP content in inputs.

specifications.model_size: 13.5 GiB of safetensors weights (14,483,497,752 bytes) in F16

training_context.adaptations: The model was aligned using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with Intel/orca_dpo_pairs.
training_context.training_data: This checkpoint is a fine-tune of mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1 on the Open-Orca/SlimOrca dataset.
